title: Music and Volcano ambient from Roblox's free licensed library, played by game state (C3)
objective: Find 6 tracks (lobby, battle, finalTwo, dungeon, results, menu) and 1 Volcano ambient loop in the Creator Store with the Studio tool server search, accept only isFree=true from creator APMOfficial or Monstercat verified by MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo, put them as a music table in Sounds.luau, and play them through a new Music module in the LavaBonk_Music group by state: lobby place -> lobby (menu while a full-screen screen is open); match MatchPhase shop/heroSelect/initializing -> menu; battle/tiebreak/roundResults -> battle; from the final_two Fx to the end of the round -> finalTwo; matchResults -> results; dungeon place -> dungeon; volcano ambient while workspace Theme is volcano during battle. Studio is driven with the section tool ../scripts/studio/studio.py; read ../scripts/studio/README.md first (outside the project, read only).
interfaces: Sounds.luau: music = { lobby = "rbxassetid://<id>", battle = ..., finalTwo = ..., dungeon = ..., results = ..., menu = ..., volcano = ... }
MusicState.track(state: { place: "lobby"|"match"|"dungeon", screenOpen: boolean, phase: string?, finalTwo: boolean, theme: string? }): (string, string?) -> music key, ambient key or nil
invariants: Library ids are not added to assets/manifest.json or Assets.luau (decision D1)
No id is used that was not returned by GetProductInfo with IsForSale/free and creator APMOfficial or Monstercat; no invented ids
Volume follows the existing Music group and Settings music volume
acceptance: Sounds.luau holds the 7 keys lobby, battle, finalTwo, dungeon, results, menu, volcano, each = "rbxassetid://<digits>", with 7 different ids; the python check prints "7 tracks".

docs/decisions.md has, for each of the 7 keys, a line '- <key>: <id> (APMOfficial, isFree)' or '- <key>: <id> (Monstercat, isFree)' whose id equals the id in Sounds.luau; the python check prints "7 verified".

tests/music_state_spec.luau asserts the 9 state cases of the objective (lobby, lobby with screen, shop, heroSelect, battle, finalTwo, matchResults, dungeon, volcano battle with ambient "volcano" and pirate battle with ambient nil) and exits 0 under lune; stylua --check and selene exit 0 on the task's Luau files.

verification.command: python3 -I -c 'import re,pathlib;t=pathlib.Path("game/src/client/common/Sounds.luau").read_text();m=dict(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(lobby|battle|finalTwo|dungeon|results|menu|volcano)\s*=\s*\"rbxassetid://([0-9]+)\"",t));d=pathlib.Path("docs/decisions.md").read_text();ok=[k for k,i in m.items() if re.search(r"- "+k+r": "+i+r" \((APMOfficial|Monstercat), isFree\)",d)];assert len(m)==7 and len(ok)==7,ok;print("7 verified")'

stylua --check src/client/common/Sounds.luau src/client/common/Music.luau src/shared/Rules/MusicState.luau tests/music_state_spec.luau && selene src/client/common/Sounds.luau src/client/common/Music.luau src/shared/Rules/MusicState.luau tests/music_state_spec.luau

qa_cases: [UI-observable] Studio play log in .bb/chats/thr_i4gi4juuyc/artifacts/c3-play-log.txt: GetProductInfo of the 7 ids prints '7 ok'; in a Lobby play session the client LavaBonk_Music group has a Sound with IsPlaying=true and the lobby SoundId; in a Match round it has the battle SoundId
